summary.text: Mary Ann Shallcross-Smith is a Democratic state representative from District 46 who took office on January 5, 2021 and is seeking re-election; she advanced from the Democratic primary on September 9, 2026.
Ballotpedia lists her as a business owner who previously held the District 46 seat from 2009 to 2010.

paragraphs.text: Shallcross-Smith lives in Lincoln, Rhode Island, and graduated from Lincoln High School in 1970.

According to Ballotpedia, she earned an associate degree in early childhood education and human services in 1982, a bachelor's degree in human services from the University of Rhode Island in 1985, a master's degree in counseling from Rhode Island College in 1989 and a doctorate in youth studies and leadership from Nova Southeastern University in 1995.
Shallcross-Smith's career experience includes owning Dr. Day Care Inc., according to Ballotpedia.
Ballotpedia lists her as having held the District 46 seat in 2009 and 2010, before returning to it in January 2021.
